Two distinct four-point collision supports on m<=5 would overlap in >=3 points; alternative completions of three ordered points force a three-term AP, so R<=1 and all cosine terms can be minimized. For A={0,1,3,4,9,10}, independent complete pair-sum enumeration gives exactly 3 collisions and unique rank-two phase relation. The exact identity cos(a)+cos(g)+cos(a+g)=2cos x cos y+2cos²x−1 has min −3/2, giving minimum 66−12=54; independent unimodular phase witness and direct convolution both give 54, rather than unattainable formal value 42.
